look_here_first: Look at a fully developed stem leaf first: narrow outline but very finely divided into many tiny fernlike segments (usually 1–2-pinnately dissected). Then inspect the flat-topped cluster of numerous tiny composite heads. Check a single head from the side for several rows of overlapping phyllaries; do not infer native status or identity from white/pink color.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Aromatic rhizomatous perennial herb; erect flowering stems, usually forming patches.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, deeply finely dissected, usually 1–2-pinnate, fernlike foliage; examine segments at magnification.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Many small capitula crowded in a relatively flat-topped corymb; usually 5–8 small ray florets around disk florets; involucral phyllaries commonly about 20–30 in several series.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: Small compressed cypselae roughly 1–2 mm, margins may be winged; inspect mature material rather than inferring from flowering heads.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: numerous small heads forming a flat-topped cluster

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: individual head with short rays and layered phyllaries
